methodology: Values are parsed from public estate-page JavaScript arrays labelled AVG Price, All HK and Volume. Source labels are retained verbatim.

The source chart slices years as four observations. Quarterly labels may use a middle/end month (for example August or September for Q3). We map the literal source month to its containing quarter; November is not a completed monthly observation.
The current quarter is explicitly partial. Five-year change compares the latest completed quarter with the same quarter five years earlier, when both source observations exist.

No interpolation, annual-to-monthly expansion, or neighbourhood index synthesis. Points with zero or fewer than ten source transactions carry a sample caution. Five-year changes are withheld if either endpoint has fewer than ten source observations.
The chart uses estate-wide all-size provider aggregates; it is neither target-unit-only nor an official quality-adjusted district index. Provider model details are not fully disclosed.
Latest estate snapshot psf may differ from the chart because data windows, cache dates and provider revisions differ. Preserve these scopes rather than overwrite one with the other.
Estate rental histories were not available from the sale-price chart; missing history remains unavailable.
Failed per-estate fetches retain the previous dated series with fetchStatus and refreshError; they never acquire a new successful retrieval date.
